segments.name: Fluent
segments.description: Commerce media and performance customer acquisition for advertisers, reached through partner sites, apps and owned digital properties.
segments.evidence: The Company determined that it has one reportable segment, "Fluent," for the purposes of segment reporting.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers pay Fluent per click, per lead or per action for customer acquisition, while media partners are paid on a revenue share or impression basis.
revenueModel.evidence: We are predominantly compensated on a negotiated or market-driven "per click," "per lead," or other "per action" basis aligned with the customer acquisition cost targets of our clients.

changes.text: In January 2026, the Company sold its Call Solutions business by selling all membership interests of Winopoly, LLC.
changes.evidence: On January 31, 2026, we completed the sale of our Call Solutions business through the sale of all the membership interests of Winopoly, LLC, an indirect subsidiary.

changes.text: In May 2024, the Company conveyed True North Loyalty, LLC to Caspian Ventures, LLC.
changes.evidence: On May 1, 2024, the Company and Caspian Ventures, LLC ("Caspian") entered into a membership interest purchase agreement pursuant to which the Company conveyed 100 % of the membership interests of True North Loyalty, LLC and its direct and indirect subsidiaries (collectively, "True North") to Caspian (the "True North Conveyance").
